description: Not a lever of the fused stack: the masked tail pass of a prompt as a trace replay (QWEN_FAST_PREFILL_TAIL_TRACE, gate only, default off). The pass below the 2,048-row bucket is host-bound (~3,155 eagerly dispatched ops); the lever captures one trace per bucket (128, 256, 512, 1,024) over persistent buffers, runs every GDN layer with valid_len = bucket and makes the pad rows inert through the gates (a persistent vector added to a and b), selects the conv state with a persistent one-hot pair, writes the pad K/V blocks to NP1's scratch page, retains the five drafter tap outputs and answers the tap layers' forward from them, and holds the regions the captures used with an arena. Its gate-only twins (-pf3-s5-ctl, -pf3-s5, the arena ladder -pf3-s5-a160 and -a80, and -pf3-s5-audit of the ship-5 candidate) are generated by make_pf3_profiles.py. Unset (the default) nothing moves: the route does not even import the module.

smoke.what: PF3-T masked tail pass as a trace replay

image_files.reason: levern_route imports it at the attach once QWEN_FAST_PREFILL_TAIL_TRACE or one of its knob flags is set (the masked tail pass of a prompt as a trace replay); an image without it refuses that boot

notes: Shared files this package edits: levern_route.py (the install, the warm and the uninstall of the lever; every change is off unless a flag is set), profile_twins.py and the census tests that exempt generated twins.
